## Applying this scope map to distributions

The scope table is interpreted in listed order (first matching repository-relative
path), with slash-separated paths and `**` matching nested paths. It records
review routing and explicit first-party declarations, not a license-detection or
relicensing engine. Existing source notices and more-specific third-party terms
remain controlling even where a broad row supplies product context. An unknown
or contradictory notice requires review; it is not an Apache-2.0 admission.

`m3/catalogue/license-scope-provenance.json` identifies the exact M3jdk21 precedent
and the preserved Nebula licenses/notices. Historical source snapshots and
EPL-licensed generated product files keep their original notices and byte seals.
The rights and authorship notices remain intact; no contributor assignment,
waiver, new patent right or additional license restriction is created here.

The canonical Grid recipe's mixed-license distribution carries both license texts,
upstream notices, attribution and source-location metadata under
`META-INF/synexia/nebula-licensing/`. The Apache-2.0 recipe wrapper does not
relicense its EPL-2.0 source fixtures. A copy of upstream notices may describe
components not bundled in that focused artifact; it is retained as provenance,
not a statement that every listed dependency is included.
